summary: The contract supplies one fixed scalar and requires two fixed conversion outputs, so there is no scalable workload and the constant-time upper bound matches the unavoidable constant output work.

optimality.argument: Any correct implementation must produce the two-element result, while two fixed arithmetic formulas and one fixed-size array construction use a constant number of operations regardless of the Celsius magnitude.

replacement_checks.evidence: Producing the required two-element conversion result requires at least one operation, establishing an Omega(1) lower bound.
The reference performs one addition, one multiplication plus addition, and one fixed-size array construction for every legal input.
Regression evaluates every legal two-decimal Celsius value from 0.00 through 1000.00 against independently written Kelvin and Fahrenheit formulas with the accepted floating-point tolerance.
